payload.text: hv's board has ONE writer at a time and vc holds that pen by standing arrangement. EXCEPTION IN FORCE 2026-09-22: cc holds it for the flense hv asked cc for directly, vc writes nothing to hv's board meanwhile, and every hv line for the flense -- vc's settled verdicts included -- goes on through cc. The pen returns to vc the moment the flense lands. Agreed by both nodes rather than assumed: a standing grant that blocks a specific live instruction is being held for its own sake, and which single node writes matters far less than that only one does.
